sources.title: beamster/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Sushi-2.6bpw · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next packed for sushi, a native inference engine for Apple Silicon. Target: a 64 GB Mac with a long context: 250k tokens at 8-bit KV, 450k at 4-bit. On 96 GB and 128 GB Macs it runs the full 1M-token context.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B MTP: the flag was free the whole time - GitHub
sources.snippet: The KV cache flags matter on their own: without them, context creation fails past roughly 90K next to 17GB of weights. With them, the full 262K window fits a 24GB card at 22.2GB (drop -c to 262144 and remove the spec flags if you want maximum window instead of maximum speed). Weights: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF. Official model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B.

sources.title: MTPLX · The fastest way to run Qwen 3.8 on a Mac
sources.snippet: The fastest way to run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next and Qwen 3.8 27B on a Mac. Free Mac app and CLI with exact native MTP: 125 tok/s on Flash Next in OpenCode, 87.6 on the 27B, M5 Max.
